info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fitness Memberships Classes-v4-spec
info.description: This API allows developers to access and retrieve information about available fitness membership classes. Users can query the classes offered under various memberships, helping them understand the options available for potential sign-ups or participation. Typical consumers include gym management systems, fitness apps, and membership platforms that aim to provide their users with curated class information. With this endpoint, businesses can enhance their offerings and improve user engagement by promoting relevant classes to their clientele.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of classes available for membership.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all the available classes that can be included with a membership. You can use it to view options for new or existing members and to evaluate class availability.
